summary.text: Emily Long is a Democratic member of the Vermont House of Representatives for the Windham-5 District, a seat she has held since January 2015, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Long has served on the House Rules Committee and the Education Committee, and during the 2023-2024 session was assigned to the Health Care Committee, the House Rules Committee as vice chair, and the Judicial Rules Committee.
